rubric: The twin of goal-demands-video: the same rename without the demand.

criteria.format: CI/CD, config, infrastructure or a pure refactor: nothing a person could watch or run to see it

reading.why: Renaming an internal constant with no surface and no browser run leaves nothing to watch or run.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: video
ruledOut.why: A pure rename with nothing to see. It is not: a UI or flow change a person should watch happen, and the browser run ran on a running system: scenarios the browser drove, a recording or replayable steps, and the video image is there.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: screenshots_or_terminal
ruledOut.why: A pure rename with nothing to see. It is not: an API or CLI change: screenshots when there is something to see, else a terminal capture of the commands and the scenarios' tests.
